newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cardoso appeals for reform approval.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cardoso appeals for reform approval.

text.p: Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso appealed to Congress to swiftly approve constitutional reforms to help reduce the country's public sector deficit.

"I make an appeal to the (party political) leaders -- the reforms are fundamental. Without them we won't have clear horizons regarding the public deficit," Cardoso said in an end-of-year speech to his cabinet.
The president said reform of the social security system was needed urgently because Treasury funds had to be used in November to fund the welfare budget.
"We need social security reform...Without reform we are going to face very difficult problems," Cardoso said.
A constitutional reform of the social security system was approved in a watered down form by the Chamber of Deputies earlier this year and is due to be rewritten in the Senate.
Cardoso also called for approval of the civil service, allowing for cuts in the public sector payroll.
